data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name 'Eadweard' meaning 'wealthy guardian'. The name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the Anglo-Saxon King Eadweard the Great (Athelstan), who ruled from 871 to 939 AD. The name Eddie carries the meaning “wealthy guardian” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eddie usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
